image_description: A medium shot of two people on a boat holding a large fish. A woman in the foreground holds a fishing rod and supports the fish's body, while a man in orange waders behind her holds the fish by a lip gripper. The background shows water and a distant bridge under an overcast sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish displays the characteristic shovel-like snout and the mouth is located on the underside (ventral), consistent with sturgeon anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Four distinct fleshy barbels are visible hanging from the snout area in front of the mouth.
The snout is elongated and tapers to a point, typical of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is long, cylindrical, and tapers at both ends, fitting the fusiform description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of large, bony plates (scutes) are clearly visible running longitudinally along the side and back of the fish; no standard fish scales are present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal side is dark gray/brown, transitioning to a white/lighter belly, matching the expected coloration.
The caudal fin is visibly asymmetrical, with the upper lobe being larger and extending further than the lower lobe, a defining trait of sturgeons.
